scope: Approved native macOS FolioNotes scope; deferred modules/platforms remain gated
method: Subjective weighted planning estimate; not verified security/correctness, percentage of code, or a release certificate.

areas.area: Mac integration, security review and release evidence

last_completed: Owner confirmed all three outstanding changes work on a rebuild: the capture panel no longer reports a phantom cancellation, File > Open Recent reopens the project, and Jump to Cursor behaves as a one-shot action. Owner's summary: 'I think it works perfectly fine for the moment.' Then, on the owner's direction to improve what exists before adding anything, a polish pass found and fixed three defects: the toolbar note picker and the sidebar shared one filter string so filtering in one silently filtered the other; six icon-only buttons in RoadmapView had no accessibility label while ConnectionsView pairs help with label on every one; and Recovery was enabled with no project open. All unverified source.
current_work: Encrypted .rdm is the owner's stated next priority. Before new work: the owner answers the explanation questions on what .rdm is and how live speech works, and the remaining original-report checklist items are walked (Split in a normal window, clicking controls after resizing to the floor, and the create/edit/save/reopen/search regression set). Live microphone and speech testing is no longer blocked -- its gate was 'not until the UI is stable', which the owner has now confirmed.
